Sparkling Tones for desktop, part two: the editor.
Click any pedal in the chain, and it comes up big, with all its knobs.
Drag a knob up or down, or use the mouse wheel. The amp follows while you play.
The list on the right has every model the Spark offers. Click one, and the pedal or the amp is swapped.
The coloured label above each block switches it on and off.
A slash B compares what you're doing with the saved preset, so you can hear the difference.
And every change can be undone, and redone.
Sparkling Tones: free, for Windows and in your browser. Next: library and banks.
